reviews.title: The App is Terrible
reviews.text: When you go to add a gift card, if you don’t see the apply button and you just hit complete order which is huge and in bright green, your gift card doesn’t actually get entered and your credit card will be charge. Additionally if you have more than one gift card, you cannot use it.  It also doesn’t save gift cards once you enter them to show the balance so you don’t have to re-enter it every time.  A lot of apps allow you to scan the gift card so you don’t have to enter every single number, but this app does not.

reviews.title: Perfect Draft kegs
reviews.text: Trying to purchase this product at Total Wine in Tallahassee. Was told they don’t carry the product. But local distributor states they have the product in stock and supply the Total Wine store in Ocala. Supervisor told me this has to go through corporate headquarters? I am willing to purchase by request if they don’t want to stock. Can’t get an answer. I spent 2K dollars at this Total Wine Tallahassee location since 1 January 2026. I guess I am destined to change all my purchases to ABC liquors from now on.

reviews.title: VIP Event: Celebrate Día de los Muertos with Cantera Negra Tequila
reviews.text: Last night Thursday, October 29, I attended this class along with three other people. I have been attending wine tastings and tequila tasting classes at Total Wine for over a year now. This class was hosted by an outside vendor not Ivan or Maria the in-house folks who normally host these classes. This class was completely underwhelming. We were all very disappointed with the presentation, the amount of tequila serving (felt like a tablespoon of tequila served in tacky plastic cups), and the length of the class. Tacos were also served and they were the worst tasting tacos I’ve ever had. The class lasted about 40 minutes not the usual two hours filled with information and the appropriate servings of wine that is normally done by the Total Wine host. This class was $35 per person and it was absolutely not worth it. Total Wine please share with your outside vendors what you do with your wine tasting classes costing $20 and have these vendors try to give a similar or better class, especially when the up-charge is so much higher.

reviews.title: Can’t add to cart & can’t delete my account
reviews.text: I can’t add anything to the cart on any platform anymore. Since I can’t buy anything online there’s no point in having an account anymore. I tried to delete my account but totalwine has made it an asinine effort to delete an account. You have to fill out an extremely long and detailed form that requires you to look up numbers, find receipts, specify information like what country you’re in, repeat fields you’ve already filled out to the point where they’ve made it so onerous to delete your account that it’s near impossible. Then there’s a disclaimer that they have 45 days to do it and may extend for another 45 days.  It’s unethical and underhanded.

reviews.title: Mr Ben
reviews.text:
Today I ordered on line a 29 year old Glenfohdry & a 21 year old. The 29 year old was given to me in a flimsy paper bag with NO BOX. When I asked for the box, she said I dont think it comes with a box & went looking for d box and found it.
This is second time I picked up an online order missing a box. Whoever is filling out on line orders should make an effort to find the proper box for the liquor. Your customers are not street winos drinking out of a paper bag! Be real! This is BAD!

reviews.title: Poor Rewards
reviews.text: There reward system is demeaning. It is so pathetic that they prey on alcoholism to save you 5 bucks after you spend 500. By far the worst rewards I have seen to date.

reviews.title: Horrible, cheap instructor
reviews.text: Dump Laura! First of all this is the third review I’ve written because your website keeps crashing. Please do something with Laura. She is not teacher material for your company. She treated every adult in the class as if we wanted to steal the wine. Where is Kim?? Laura was able to pour one bottle of wine for a class of thirty and if we asked for a revisit, you got the naughty parent stare. I sign up for classes for fun, to meet other adults in my age category and for the introduction to new wines. I will say Laura seems well versed on wine. I come to your classes to drink, get introduced to new wines and spend money  after class, it’s fun. 2/12 was the most disciplined class I attended. At the end, Laura refused to let us revisit and hid the wine as if we were addicts! During all this craziness that’s going on in the world, I used my local Total Wines and More as a store to have fun. I absolutely look forward to these events. I’ve even convinced several other people to attend.

reviews.title: Losing its appeal
reviews.text:
I can’t speak highly enough about the employees at my local store. They are the best. They do a fantastic job at recommending wines and helping with the discounts & “rewards”. 

I have in the past activated “my reward” for “use in store” while in my car before walking into the store (yes, confirmation received). When I get to checkout, it’s not there. 

Recent development: a Winery Direct designation wine I’ve purchased many times as part of membership 10% off 6 or 15% off 12 held up a $500 wine purchase because “those two bottles (Joe Wagner Pinots) had a “sale” price if customer purchased two bottles. I am the one that noticed my discount percent was less than expected. On any other day I would be in a hurry to knock another line item off my to-do list. I kept the two Wagners but had to add two more bottles of something that was not “on sale”. 

It has been a few 3+/- months since I’ve shopped there again. I did so to get my $5 reward before it expired. 

#1 Rewards are earned and should never expire unless the earner expires.
#2 The wines are scattered in multiple places and only ONE of the three places had an “on sale” tag for the above-referenced Wagner. I almost got cheated through no fault of the employee. 
#3 TW&M, having almost cheated me, no longer has my trust. 
#4 Yes, today’s purchase was to get my $5 & 15% but going forward having lost my trust, my loyalty is also lost. t was good while it lasted.

reviews.title: Totowa Square Brach Customer Assistants and Cashier’s
reviews.text:
I would like to share my experience regarding the customer service at Totowa Square Branch. Unfortunately, the customer service representative ( he was wearing pink trousers and white shirt with glasses mid 50’s) were extremely rude. While one representative was speaking with another customer, I politely asked for assistance, thinking the conversation had ended. Instead of responding calmly, the representative shouted at me and said, “I am currently helping another customer,” in a very harsh and disrespectful manner.

This behavior was highly unprofessional. The same message could have been communicated politely and respectfully. In addition, the cashiers are consistently unfriendly and appear unhappy. I do not understand the reason for this attitude, as I always approach staff with a smile and try to receive service in a respectful and problem-free way. Unfortunately, Todoline at Todo Square has been very disappointing in terms of customer service.

reviews.title: Order problems
reviews.text: I had two orders that was supposed to be delivered. The driver showed up and gave me one of my orders. I thought maybe another driver was going to be bringing my other order. Suddenly I get a notification that both orders had been delivered. The funny thing is he couldn’t get my drivers license to scan . So he manually put it in. I signed and he went to his car. Suddenly he comes back and says for some reason it didn’t validate and had to do it a second time……then I get the notifications that both had been delivered and I did not get my second order. All they could offer is a redelivery the next day. I am supposed to be gone! That’s why I ordered it the day before so I could get my order. Now I have to inconvenience  someone else to get my delivery. I’m not saying he stole it but I didn’t get my order. I spend so much money with them and this is the best they could do ? I think I’ll find a better store and take my $800 a month elsewhere
